coordinates.origin: Floor-contact center of skull or explicit neutral mount base; preserve meter scale

concept.reason: Original paper supplies actual right/left/dorsal/ventral/posterior fossil photographs and interpretive drawings; no synthetic concept is needed. This is a source-guided preserved skull study, not a living reconstruction.

scope: Original low-poly interpretation of the preserved upper skull only. No mandible, teeth, neck, body, skin or inferred complete skeleton. Not a scan or exact specimen replica.
era: Middle Miocene, Collón Curá Formation, Comallo, Río Negro, Argentina; formation attribution and approximately 15.7 Ma correlation follow original paper, not an exact specimen date.
material_policy: Palette-only opaque PBR, muted warm fossil-bone colours. No reference-image textures. Subtle angular surface damage, no fabricated engraved sutures or ornamental cracks.

notes: 716 mm is approximate in source. Postorbital width is calculated by doubling one side per table footnote.
Other depths/heights must be estimated from preserved multi-view plates, explicitly labelled artistic working dimensions, never asserted as measured anatomy.
Do not normalize the exported model to a unit cube. Neutral display support optional and excluded from skull measurements.

diagnostic_targets: Exceptionally elongated rostrum, occupying over half total skull length; strong downward-curving sharp terminal hook visible in side silhouette.
Dorsal outline narrows strongly toward beak, with much wider caudal skull; do not turn entire skull into a broad short eagle beak.
Low subrectangular orbit bounded by thick roof and stout tall jugal bar, plus smaller separate antorbital opening and small caudodorsal nostril.
Flattened/as-preserved posterior skull; preserve irregular break margins and open gaps, not a pristine symmetric rebuilt skull.
No lower jaw or teeth. Posterior palatal elements missing; do not fill with smooth solid plate or mirror a complete invented quadrate.
Retain broad posterior table and simple triangular foramen-magnum opening if visible at display scale. Small detailed foramina may be omitted, not exaggerated.
uncertainties: Specimen is dorsoventrally crushed. Preserve observed condition; no undeformed living skull reconstruction.
Most posterior palate is missing; only portions of left pterygoid/quadrate preserved. No mirrored complete posterior floor.
Original fossil has asymmetry and damage. Simplification is not an exact metrical replica or claim of complete anatomy.
Natural fossil colour in plates varies with lighting; chosen warm palette is artistic.
acceptance_checklist: Side profile reads long hooked fossil bird skull, not modern eagle, mammal or full bird.
True visible apertures and separation of orbit / antorbital fenestra / nares, not dark painted spots.
Dorsal taper and broad caudal table agree with Fig4; side height follows crushed fossil plates.
Absence of lower jaw and posterior missing palate explicit in metadata and geometry.
Exact GLB views plus cheap two rebuilds and standard format/geometry tests; independent review separate from maker.

source_evidence.primary: Bertelli, Chiappe & Tambussi 2007, Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 27(2):409–419. Figures2–6 and Table1 inspected directly.
